requirements.text: Create a backend data model to store poems with fields: title (text), content (text), author (text), dateCreated (timestamp), and a unique identifier
acceptanceCriteria: Poem data structure includes all specified fields
Each poem has a unique identifier for retrieval
Poems can be stored and retrieved from the backend

requirements.text: Implement backend methods to add new poems, retrieve all poems, and retrieve a single poem by ID
acceptanceCriteria: Backend provides a method to add a new poem
Backend provides a method to list all poems
Backend provides a method to get a specific poem by ID

requirements.text: Create a home page displaying a grid or list of all poems with their titles and authors, allowing users to click through to read the full poem
acceptanceCriteria: Home page shows all poems in an organized layout
Each poem preview displays at least the title and author
Clicking on a poem navigates to its detail view

requirements.text: Create a poem detail page that displays the full poem content including title, author, content text, and date created
acceptanceCriteria: Detail page shows complete poem information
Content is readable and properly formatted
Page includes navigation back to the home page

requirements.text: Create an admin interface or form to add new poems to the collection with fields for title, content, and author
acceptanceCriteria: Form includes input fields for title, content, and author
Form validates that required fields are filled
Successfully submitted poems appear in the collection

requirements.text: Apply a creative, literary-inspired visual theme with elegant typography, warm earth tones or soft pastels, and a clean layout that emphasizes readability and creates a contemplative atmosphere suitable for poetry
acceptanceCriteria: Design uses a cohesive color palette appropriate for literary content
Typography choices enhance readability and aesthetic appeal
Layout creates a calm, focused reading experience
